notes.title: Update "SphereRun"
notes.notes: The new update for CubeRun "SphereRun" is finally here. Do you have what it takes to complete the levels?

notes.title: New update with 15 new levels
notes.notes:
The new update for CubeRun are now live. 15 brand new levels and 5 new achievements. The themes for the new levels are "Dreamhack", "Nightcore" and "Drum and Bass". 

CubeRun a challenging game with 60 levels and 25 Achievements. 
Can you beat them all.

notes.title: New Update 03/28
notes.notes:
Added Level Select
Play all of the levels in the Level Select scene

Achievements can't be earned through the level selection
All coins are removed when you play a level through the level selection

notes.title: Thanks for a great release day
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

Thanks for an amazing day yesterday. Got more copies sold then I expected. I will continue to work on the game and fix and change small things. 

I will also add new content to the game. The first new content update will arrive in approximately 1-2 weeks. 

Stay tuned

best regards
Gunnevik
